verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. No single declaration states the biconditional. It is obtained in a few lines: rowDensity_increment plus linearDensity_on_patch give that the five moments are exactly affine in the order-n corrections, m_n = m⁰_n + (∫R·δU, ∫R²δE, 2A∫R^{-2-2λ}δE, A∫R^{1-2λ}δU, -A∫R^{-2λ}δE); dividing rows 3,4,5 by 2A, A, -A turns the five conditions into the two systems with right-hand sides -d_{U,n}, -d_{E,n} in the normalization of eq-p052-1, and matrixEquiv_apply says the left-hand sides are B_Uα_n and B_Eβ_n for δU = Σα_j b_j^U, δE = Σβ_j b_j^E. Direction ⇐ is what the construction uses (weighted_moments_exact, line 192); direction ⇒ is coefficients_unique together with the invertibility of the two matrices. Instantiation difference, not a mathematical one: the paper allows any nonnegative bumps with ordered disjoint supports in J_pos normalized by ∫b_j dR = 1, while Lean fixes the cell bumps of FiveRowRank.cellLower/cellUpper and never uses the normalization.
